1392216.summary: Seattle opens the 2026 regular season at Lumen Field in a Wednesday-night Super Bowl LX rematch. This is a major-event day downtown: the Seahawks will raise their Super Bowl LX championship banner, the official Ticketmaster Tailgate opens at 2:00 p.m., all stadium gates open at 3:30 p.m., and the Mariners have a 1:10 p.m. game that removes the Mariners Garage and Lumen Field North Lot from Seahawks parking availability. Link light rail is the strongest transit option; Sound Transit does not currently list special Seahawks Sounder event service for this game.

alerts.title: Mariners game removes major Seahawks parking inventory
alerts.text: The Seahawks transportation advisory says the Mariners play at 1:10 p.m. and that the Lumen Field North Lot and Mariners Garage are unavailable for Seahawks parking. Existing parking pass holders were sent relocation details by email. Fans driving should reserve another garage before game day or use transit.

alerts.title: Super Bowl LX banner celebration
alerts.text: The Seahawks list NFL Kickoff and the Super Bowl LX Banner Celebration as the Week 1 gameday theme.

alerts.title: No special Sounder game train currently listed
alerts.text: Sound Transit's current Seahawks event-service calendar lists special Sounder service for selected later home games but does not list September 9. Do not plan on a special postgame Sounder train unless Sound Transit adds service.

transportation.name: Link light rail
transportation.recommendation: Recommended for most fans traveling from north Seattle, Lynnwood, downtown, the airport corridor or south King County.
transportation.details: Sound Transit's 1 Line serves both Stadium and International District/Chinatown stations near Lumen Field. Because this is a Wednesday rush-hour game and nearby parking is constrained by the Mariners game, allow extra time and expect crowded trains.

transportation.name: King County Metro
transportation.recommendation: Useful for Seattle-area trips, but check the weekday schedule and leave extra time.
transportation.details: More than 15 regular Metro routes stop within three blocks of Lumen Field. The former dedicated Seahawks park-and-ride game bus service is no longer offered.

transportation.name: Washington State Ferries
transportation.recommendation: Reasonable option for Bainbridge and Bremerton travelers when paired with the walk from Colman Dock.
transportation.details: Seattle-Bainbridge and Seattle-Bremerton ferries arrive at Colman Dock, within walking distance of Lumen Field. Check the sailing schedule before leaving because the game ends in the evening.

transportation.name: Sounder
transportation.recommendation: Do not rely on a special game train for this Wednesday opener.
transportation.details: Sound Transit currently lists special Seahawks Sounder service for selected later games, not September 9. Fans coming from Tacoma, Lakewood, Everett or other Sounder communities should verify regular weekday schedules and their postgame return option before choosing Sounder.

parking.name: Lumen Field North Lot
parking.details: Unavailable for Seahawks parking for this game because of the 1:10 p.m. Mariners game. The lot is also normally presold rather than offered as day-of single-game parking.

parking.name: Mariners Garage
parking.details: Unavailable for Seahawks parking because the Mariners play at 1:10 p.m. Parking-pass holders affected by the conflict were sent relocation information.

parking.name: Off-site reserved parking
parking.details: The Seahawks direct single-game drivers to reserve nearby parking in advance. Do not expect to buy a space in the Lumen Field North Lot or Lumen Field Garage on game day.

timeline.details: The overlapping Mariners game materially affects SODO parking and traffic.
Official Seahawks pregame event inside the Lumen Field Event Center.

timeline.event: Suites and Delta Sky360 Club open

timeline.details: Legends autograph sessions are scheduled at Ticketmaster Tailgate in two one-hour windows.
The Seahawks recommend having mobile tickets ready before reaching the turnstiles.

tailgates.name: Ticketmaster Tailgate
tailgates.description: Official Seahawks pregame event for ticketed fans. Week 1 includes live entertainment, Seahawks Legends autograph sessions, a gaming zone, kid-friendly activities, a sports bar area, Pro Shop merchandise and a Taste-Off featuring $12 Sloppy Joe and Cuban Sandwich options. The first 10,000 fans entering the tailgate receive a commemorative ticket.

watchParties.name: Seahawks vs. Patriots NFL Kickoff Party at The Dock
watchParties.location: The Dock Sports Bar & Grill, Fremont, Seattle
watchParties.description: The Dock is explicitly advertising a Seahawks-Patriots kickoff party with a live DJ, outdoor beer garden and wall-to-wall game coverage.

stadiumTips.title: All tickets are mobile
stadiumTips.details: Download or update the Seahawks app and load your tickets before arriving. Lumen Field's new turnstiles allow a group to scan all tickets at the reader and then proceed through one at a time after each ticket shows a green check.

stadiumTips.title: Tailgating is not permitted on Lumen Field property
stadiumTips.details: Traditional vehicle tailgating is prohibited in Lumen Field-owned lots. Use the official Ticketmaster Tailgate or a verified off-site event instead.

stadiumTips.title: Week 1 stadium giveaway
stadiumTips.details: The Seahawks gameday guide says fans in attendance will receive an exclusive blue or green Ring Pop Colorfest ring.

weather.summary: Mostly sunny in the current National Weather Service forecast.

1392244.summary: Seattle's first road game is at State Farm Stadium in Glendale. No sufficiently verified Seahawks-specific Puget Sound watch party or traveling Seahawks tailgate for this game was found yet. Fans traveling to Arizona should prepare for mobile entry, the NFL clear-bag rules and cashless stadium operations.

parking.name: State Farm Stadium parking
parking.details: Use the Cardinals' official game-specific parking information when released and arrive early; security checkpoints are typically busiest during the final 30 minutes before kickoff.

timeline.details: Seahawks at Cardinals at State Farm Stadium.

stadiumTips.title: State Farm Stadium clear-bag rules
stadiumTips.details: Approved clear bags may not exceed 12 x 12 x 6 inches; one-gallon clear freezer bags and small clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 x 2 inches are also permitted.

stadiumTips.title: State Farm Stadium is cashless
stadiumTips.details: The Cardinals identify State Farm Stadium as a 100% cashless venue.

stadiumTips.title: Mobile bag check is available
stadiumTips.details: Non-compliant bags can currently be stored at two mobile bag-check locations outside the security perimeter for $20 per bag. Recheck this price before the game because it is time-sensitive.

1392256.summary: Seattle visits Northwest Stadium for a 10:00 a.m. Pacific kickoff. No verified Seahawks-specific Seattle-area watch party or traveling Seahawks tailgate was found yet. For fans traveling, Commanders parking is pass-controlled and stadium tailgating is permitted in most lots under specific rules.

transportation.name: Washington Metro
transportation.recommendation: Check the Commanders' official gameday transportation page immediately before travel.
transportation.details: The Commanders maintain Metro information as part of their official stadium gameday resources.

parking.name: Northwest Stadium parking
parking.details: A pre-purchased parking pass is required for official stadium lots. Passes correspond to a specific color and letter lot.

stadiumTips.title: Tailgating is allowed in most official lots
stadiumTips.details: Northwest Stadium permits tailgating in most parking lots, except H-Burgundy and team/staff lots. Tailgating must end by kickoff.

stadiumTips.title: Clear-bag policy
stadiumTips.details: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags and small clutches around 4.5 x 6.5 inches are permitted.

stadiumTips.title: Mobile tickets only
stadiumTips.details: Commanders tickets are mobile; printed PDFs and screenshots are not accepted.

stadiumTips.title: Some outside food and water are permitted
stadiumTips.details: Current Broncos guidance allows individual food in an approved clear bag and unfrozen factory-sealed non-alcoholic drinks; empty plastic water bottles under 34 ounces are also permitted. Recheck before the game.

transportation.details: Raiders gameday materials have used RTC Game Day Express service for home games; exact 2026 service for Seahawks-Raiders should be reconfirmed closer to November.

stadiumTips.title: Tailgating is restricted to designated areas

stadiumTips.title: No glass containers in parking lots

1392443.summary: Seattle hosts the Rams at Lumen Field on Christmas night. Holiday transit schedules, ferry service, restaurant hours and road conditions will need to be checked much closer to December 25. The Seahawks' official Ticketmaster Tailgate policy says the event operates at every home game and opens three hours before kickoff.

alerts.title: Christmas Day service schedules will differ
alerts.text: Transit, ferry and local business schedules may operate on holiday timetables. Current September schedules should not be used for December 25 planning.

transportation.name: Link light rail
transportation.recommendation: Likely the best transit option, but verify Christmas Day service before travel.
transportation.details: The 1 Line normally serves Stadium and International District/Chinatown stations near Lumen Field. Holiday frequency and operating hours require a fresh check.

transportation.name: Washington State Ferries
transportation.recommendation: Verify Christmas Day sailing schedules before relying on a ferry connection.
transportation.details: Bainbridge and Bremerton routes normally reach Colman Dock near the stadium, but holiday service may differ.

1392467.summary: Seattle plays Carolina in Charlotte in Week 17. No verified Seahawks-specific Charlotte tailgate or Puget Sound watch party was found yet. Bank of America Stadium has substantial privately operated parking nearby and encourages advance reservations, while Charlotte light rail is a practical stadium-access option.

transportation.name: CATS light rail / transit
transportation.recommendation: Strong option for fans staying in the Charlotte area.
transportation.details: Panthers transportation guidance recommends light rail and transit as alternatives to driving. Recheck January service and fares before the game.

parking.name: Uptown Charlotte parking
parking.details: The Panthers report more than 30,000 parking spaces within a 10-15 minute walk of Bank of America Stadium, primarily operated by independent parking operators. Advance reservation is recommended.

stadiumTips.title: Clear-bag policy
stadiumTips.details: Bank of America Stadium allows transparent plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches and small purses or clutches no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches.

stadiumTips.title: Stadium is cashless
stadiumTips.details: Purchases at Bank of America Stadium are cashless.

stadiumTips.title: No stadium-property tailgating
stadiumTips.details: The Panthers state that tailgating is prohibited at the stadium itself; rules in privately operated surrounding lots vary by operator.

1392478.summary: Seattle closes the regular season on the road against the Rams on January 9 or 10, 2027. The Seahawks and NFL still list the exact Week 18 date, kickoff time and network as TBD. No Seahawks-specific Los Angeles tailgate or watch party is listed because none was verified this far in advance.

alerts.title: Week 18 exact date and kickoff time are not finalized
alerts.text: The NFL calendar places Week 18 on January 9 or 10, 2027, while the Seahawks' official schedule lists the exact date, kickoff time and network as TBD. Recheck both schedules before publishing travel or event times.

transportation.name: LA Metro and SoFi Stadium shuttle
transportation.recommendation: Consider transit instead of driving once the Week 18 date and kickoff time are finalized.
transportation.details: For the 2026-27 NFL season, Rams parking guidance says the SoFi Stadium shuttle boards at the LAX/Metro Transit Center rather than Hawthorne/Lennox.

transportation.name: Rideshare
transportation.recommendation: Use the designated SoFi rideshare area instead of arranging a pickup directly at the stadium curb.
transportation.details: The Rams designate a rideshare area on Kareem Court via Pincay Drive, using 3178 Pincay Dr., Inglewood, as the recommended address.

parking.name: SoFi Stadium on-site parking
parking.details: On-site parking must be purchased in advance; the Rams state that event-day parking is not sold at SoFi Stadium. Current season parking is sold out, with single-game inventory available through resale.

parking.name: City of Inglewood Park & Go
parking.details: The Rams list the City of Inglewood Park & Go system as an off-site parking alternative.

timeline.details: NFL Week 18 is January 9 or 10, 2027; the exact date and kickoff time have not yet been finalized.

stadiumTips.title: Tailgating only in the Pink Zone
stadiumTips.details: SoFi Stadium permits NFL tailgating only in the Pink Zone. That lot opens five hours before kickoff.

stadiumTips.title: Parking zones open four hours before kickoff
stadiumTips.details: Most SoFi parking zones open four hours before kickoff; the Pink Zone opens five hours before kickoff.

stadiumTips.title: Mobile tickets and clear-bag rules
stadiumTips.details: SoFi entry is mobile-ticket only; screenshots are not accepted because ticket barcodes rotate. NFL clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches and small bags up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches are permitted.
